def factor_ts_size_adaptive_earnings_book(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    size_mean = df_copy['mkt_cap_float'].rolling(60, min_periods=20).mean()
    size_std = df_copy['mkt_cap_float'].rolling(60, min_periods=20).std(ddof=0)
    size_z = (df_copy['mkt_cap_float'] - size_mean) / size_std.replace(0, np.nan)
    ey = 1.0 / df_copy['pe_ttm'].replace(0, np.nan)
    by = 1.0 / df_copy['pb_lf'].replace(0, np.nan)
    lev = df_copy['debttoassets'] / 100.0
    lev_penalty = (1.0 - lev).clip(lower=0.0)
    df_copy['factor_ts_size_adaptive_earnings_book'] = np.where(
        size_z > 0, ey, by * lev_penalty
    )
    return df_copy['factor_ts_size_adaptive_earnings_book']
